crosswalks.label: Compliance Officers
crosswalks.rationale: Compliance Officers is a bounded occupational baseline for Compliance Operations Specialist; AXM profession identity/authority/maturity remain separate.

findings.summary: Compliance Operations must keep requirement/evidence workflow separate from legal interpretation, certification and specialist security/privacy/quality acceptance.
findings.rationale: Research-first compilation makes the boundary explicit before use.

gaps_against_body.description: Make evidence-completeness-versus-legal-compliance, requirement-version and authority boundaries explicit.

nonclaims: No complete Compliance Operations Specialist reconstruction is claimed.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent institutional authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No role label, package, model capability, repository permission or coordination function creates constitutional, product, professional or institutional authority.
